column1: # MagNET Hanasu — OTA partition table for 4 MB C6 parts (OTA-PACKAGE §7.3).
# Two 1792 KB app slots: the BLE+LED image is ~1.16 MB (65 % of a slot; the
# Thread-only image ~852 KB). 1216 KB slots were tried first and left the BLE
# image at 93 % — no room to grow. NVS stays
# at 0x9000 / 24 KB exactly as in partitions.csv
# channel and BLE bonds survive the move. Moving a node onto this table is
# USB-only (a partition table cannot change over the air). `scripts`
# (LittleFS) is reserved — no firmware uses it today (Forth scripts and role
# bundles live in NVS) — so it shrinks 960 KB -> 384 KB and moves.
